newsitem.title: USA: San Juan, Puerto Rico, eyes $350 mln capital plan.
newsitem.headline: San Juan, Puerto Rico, eyes $350 mln capital plan.

text.p: San Juan, Puerto Rico, is eyeing a four-year, roughly $350 million capital improvement program and could start with a sale of about $100 million of bonds in fiscal 1998, the newly elected mayor said Thursday.

Sila M. Calderon, elected with over 90 percent of the vote in November, said the much needed capital program would be financed with debt and would be used mostly for healthcare facilities, infrastructure development and improvement, security and assisting the poor communities.
Calderon made her remarks at a Municipal Forum of New York luncheon here at the India House in Lower Manhattan.
